projectFindings.name: GameSync Source Finder / Entity Resolver
facts: GameSync Next now has a source-backed typed discovery engine at packages/shared/src/modSourceDiscovery.ts and a React Found Mods workflow at apps/extension-v2/src/ui/app/FoundModsView.tsx.

The canonical parity matrix marks source-discovery-and-found-mods verified and records isolated Opera execution of the packaged offscreen MiniLM/WASM reranker with valid scores while keeping broader provider equivalence separate.
FoundModsView currently requests discovered rows with offset 0 and limit 5000, creating a hard source-level completeness ceiling that violates the complete-library/no-cap requirement.
The manual user-initiated Found Mods merge path accepts intelLibraryMatch confidence >= 0.45; this must remain distinct from the shipping Hybrid Matcher automatic attach threshold >= 0.86.
projectFindings.proposal: Replace the 5000-row ceiling with a lossless complete-data retrieval strategy and add a >5000-discovery regression covering filtering, Add, manual Merge, Ignore, reload, and restart without viewport culling or quantity loss.

projectFindings.name: GameSync Script Polling Runtime
facts: ScriptPollScheduler constructor installs an alarm listener through setupAlarms().
stopScheduledPolls() clears the alarm, removes the listener, and sets alarmListener to null.
schedulePolls() recreates the alarm but does not reinstall the listener.
In the same live service-worker instance, stop then start can therefore leave the named recurring alarm present with no registered callback until scheduler reconstruction.

Persisted lastPollAt provides overdue-source detection once runScheduledPolls executes, but this pass did not establish an explicit startup caller that guarantees missed-window catch-up after browser/service-worker restart.
projectFindings.proposal: Repair the same-worker stop/start listener lifecycle, add an exact STOP -> START -> alarm-fire regression, then prove browser/service-worker restart and missed-window catch-up in the built extension.
